Operator.title: Operator
Operator.description: Represents a cleaning operator within the WorkForce Hub application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Operator entity.

username.description: The unique operator code used for login.

firstName.description: The first name of the cleaning operator.

lastName.description: The last name of the cleaning operator.

workSchedule.description: The contractual work schedule for the operator. Start time is optional.

totalHours.description: Total contractual hours for the day.

startTime.description: Optional: The specific start time for the shift (e.g., '08:00'). Used for lateness calculations.

Admin.title: Admin
Admin.description: Represents an administrator within the WorkForce Hub application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Admin entity.

firstName.description: The first name of the administrator.

lastName.description: The last name of the administrator.

Timbratura.title: Timbratura
Timbratura.description: Represents a single clock-in/out event. Break start/end events are now typically added by an admin.

userId.description: The ID of the user who made the clocking event.

timestamp.description: The exact date and time of the clocking event.

latitude.description: The latitude of the location where the event occurred.

longitude.description: The longitude of the location where the event occurred.

status.description: The approval status of the clocking event.

viewedByOperator.description: Indicates if the operator has seen the status change made by an admin.

Straordinario.title: Straordinario
Straordinario.description: Represents a single overtime shift performed on a non-working day.

Request.title: Request
Request.description: Represents a user request for leave, overtime, etc.

userId.description: The ID of the user making the request.

startDate.description: The start date/time of the request.

endDate.description: The end date/time of the request.

hours.description: The number of hours requested (for 'permesso' or 'straordinario').

reason.description: An optional reason for the request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the request was created.

viewedByOperator.description: Indicates if the operator has seen the status change made by an admin.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Represents a product in the warehouse.

SupplyRequest.title: SupplyRequest
SupplyRequest.description: Represents a supply request from an operator.

userId.description: The ID of the operator making the request.

productId.description: The ID of the requested product.

productName.description: The name of the requested product (denormalized).

requestedQuantity.description: The quantity requested by the operator.

approvedQuantity.description: The quantity approved by the admin.

status.description: The status of the supply request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the request was created.

viewedByOperator.description: Indicates if the operator has seen the status change made by an admin.

definition.description: Stores information about all users (admins and operators).

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user.

definition.description: A collection to store admin roles. Existence of a document with the user's ID in this collection grants admin privileges.

params.name: adminId
params.description: The unique identifier of the administrator.
